feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 9:03am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

NW or W-NW 3 or 4, soon backing SW or Southerly 2 to 4, then SE 4 or 5 this evening, increasing 5 or 6 tonight. Veering Southerly 4 or 5 at the end of the night.


##State of sea)##

Slight at first, falling smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Mostly fair, then rain arriving overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in the rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
